How it works

Four steps. No jargon.

About

I'm Shihab, the person behind SK DigiWorks. No account managers, no hand-offs — you message me, I build it, you review it with me. I focus on local businesses because a good website makes a visible difference for them: more calls, more WhatsApp enquiries, more people walking in who found you on Google first.

Why a website, honestly

Instagram isn't search.

When someone needs a dentist, a cafe or a boutique right now, they search Google — not Instagram. If you have no website and no proper listing, that customer goes to the business that does. A simple, fast site fixes that, and it works for you every day without you posting anything.

Questions

Before you ask.

Is the demo really free?

Yes. I build a demo version of your website with your business name and content, and you review it on your phone. You only pay if you decide to go ahead and make it live. If you don't like it, you owe nothing.

I don't have a logo, photos or written content. Can you still start?

Yes. Phone photos of your shop, menu or work are enough to start, and I can help structure your services and wording. If you need a simple logo, tell me on WhatsApp and we'll sort it out as part of the conversation.

What do you need from me to begin?

Just the basics: your business name, what you offer, your city, timings, and a WhatsApp number for enquiries. Send it through the form below or straight on WhatsApp — it takes about five minutes.

Will my site work on phones?

That's the priority. Every site is designed mobile-first and tested on a phone screen, with click-to-call and WhatsApp buttons placed where thumbs actually reach.

Can you update the site later — prices, photos, offers?

Yes. Message me the change on WhatsApp and I'll update it. Small text and photo changes are part of looking after a site properly — we'll agree the details when we start.
